description: Test suite for Sales Order functionalities in ERPNext, including creation, updates, cancellations, and related document interactions.

classes.name: TestSalesOrder
classes.description: Test case class for Sales Order operations, including creation, updates, cancellations, and related document interactions.

methods.name: make_sales_order
methods.description: Creates a new Sales Order with specified parameters, optionally saving and submitting it.

methods.name: create_dn_against_so
methods.description: Creates and submits a Delivery Note against a Sales Order with optional delivered quantity.

methods.name: get_reserved_qty
methods.description: Retrieves the reserved quantity of an item in a specific warehouse.

methods.name: automatically_fetch_payment_terms
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic fetching of payment terms for Sales Orders and Invoices.

methods.name: compare_payment_schedules
methods.description: Compares payment schedules between Sales Order and Sales Invoice documents for consistency.

methods.name: make_sales_order_workflow
methods.description: Creates or activates a test workflow for Sales Orders with approval conditions.
